map.执行后自动生成解读。: Analysis appears after you run the tool.
map.下面的解读由本页面在你浏览器里对刚才的结果做本地分析得出，不上传、不调用额外接口: The analysis below is computed locally in your browser from the result you just got. Nothing is uploaded and no extra requests are made. For troubleshooting reference only, not a substitute for professional judgment.
map.最近一次成功结果只保存在你本机浏览器（localStorage），不上传。可展开: Your last successful result is stored only in this browser (localStorage) and is never uploaded. Expand a row to compare the current output with the previous one. Clearing site data removes the record.
map.以下工具与本页面常一起使用：: Tools commonly used with this page:
map.向 3 个公共 STUN 分别取 srflx 映射的 IP:端口，按端口是否一致: Query srflx mappings from 3 public STUN servers and infer cone vs symmetric NAT from port consistency.
map.向多个 STUN 服务器分别发起映射请求，比较返回的公网映射端口：若各服务器看到: Queries several STUN servers for their public mappings and compares ports: identical ports suggest cone NAT; different ports suggest symmetric NAT. Heuristic only, not a precise detection.
map.尚未有运行记录，点击上方「推断 NAT」开始。: No run history yet. Click "Infer NAT" above to start.
map.每个 STUN 服务器看到的公网 IP:端口: Public IP:port seen by each STUN server
map.这是启发式推断，受多出口、运营商多级 NAT、STUN 可用性影响，仅供网络排查: Heuristic inference affected by multi-homing, carrier NAT tiers and STUN availability — for troubleshooting reference only.
map.锥形和对称有什么区别？: What is the difference between cone and symmetric NAT?
map.锥形 NAT 对外端口固定，便于 P2P 直连；对称 NAT 对每目标分配不同端: Cone NAT uses a fixed external port (easier P2P); symmetric assigns a different port per destination (harder to traverse).
map.少于 2 个 STUN 返回有效映射时无法比较，通常是网络限制或 STUN 不可: Fewer than 2 valid STUN mappings to compare, usually network restrictions or unreachable STUN.
map.检测会向你输入的目标地址或公开接口发起请求，结果只在本地展示，页面不保存查询记录: Checks send requests to the address you enter or to public endpoints; results are shown locally only and no query history is saved on the page. Conclusions are for troubleshooting reference and do not replace professional judgment.
map.本页不向任何 STUN 服务器发起请求，也不发送 WebRTC/网络候选信息。仅: This page does not contact any STUN server or send WebRTC/network candidates. A browser page alone cannot reliably distinguish cone/restricted/port-restricted/symmetric NAT; for exact classification, use a self-hosted STUN/TURN in a controlled environment after privacy and compliance review.
map.路由器 NAT/端口映射/UPnP 状态页: Router NAT / port mapping / UPnP status page
map.两台不同网络设备尝试 P2P 直连，记录是否必须中继: Try P2P between two devices on different networks and record whether relaying is required
map.不访问 STUN，不给出猜测的 NAT 类型: No STUN access and no guessed NAT type
map.为什么页面不检测？: Why does the page not test?
map.STUN 检测会把网络候选信息发往第三方服务器。本页选择不访问，改为提供本地排查: STUN testing sends network candidates to third-party servers. This page does not contact them and instead provides local checks, avoiding an external dependency by default.
map.锥形 NAT 对外端口相对固定，便于 P2P 直连；对称 NAT 对每个目标分配: Cone NAT keeps a relatively stable external port, which helps P2P; symmetric NAT assigns a different port per destination, making P2P harder.
map.需要精确结果怎么办？: How can I get an exact result?
map.在受控环境自建 STUN/TURN 服务，并确认数据合规、授权与日志策略后再检测: Run a self-hosted STUN/TURN in a controlled environment after confirming data compliance, authorization and logging policy; do not use public STUN casually.
